title: RaBitQ domain-specific Givens quantizer views
hypothesis: A shared paid random rotation basis plus one per-domain Givens angle and domain-specific RaBitQ code stream will approach independent per-domain random rotations while using at least 25% fewer complete basis+index bytes; post-quantization orthogonal views on one code stream should preserve rankings exactly and yield no new function.
physical_object: One D×D FAISS random orthogonal rotation basis and one 1-bit-per-dimension RaBitQ quantizer/code stream.
mirror_coordinate: One scalar Givens angle m_d per query domain, applied before the shared random rotation and quantization. Every domain-specific code stream and FAISS quantizer state is charged.
logical_multiplicity: Domain-specific approximate ranking functions over one shared random-rotation basis; a separate exact-geometry post-quantization control rotates both query and decoded reconstruction.

data.ground_truth: Exact Euclidean top-10 on the untransformed database; all view transforms are orthogonal and leave exact ranking invariant.

quantizer.basis: FAISS RandomRotationMatrix(D,D), seeded once for shared-basis arms
quantizer.domain_transform: same full-pair Givens rotation over 64 adjacent coordinate pairs; one angle scalar per domain

controls: unrotated shared RaBitQ single code stream
shared random-rotation RaBitQ single code stream
Mirror shared random rotation plus dev-selected per-domain Givens angles and separate domain code streams
independent random rotation plus separate RaBitQ code stream per domain
post-quantization orthogonal gauge: rotate query and decoded reconstruction together from the same code stream

selection.selection_metric: per-domain Recall@10; choose one angle per domain on development world 103600 only

quality: mean absolute and signed distance-estimator error on returned top-10 candidates
metrics.storage: actual serialized FAISS index bytes plus actual FP32 rotation basis bytes plus all per-domain angles/manifests

success_gate: On all three fresh worlds, Mirror per-domain mean Recall@10 is within 1 percentage point of independent-rotation control; improves on the shared single-index result by at least 2 points in at least 3/4 domains; complete Mirror payload is at least 25% smaller than independent-rotation bank; and transform+search QPS is no more than 10% slower than the independent control.
failure_gate: Mirror fails any storage/quality/runtime gate, a shared single index ties or beats Mirror, or gains require storing every domain bitstream without a net byte advantage.

paid_objects: each serialized RaBitQ index including codes and centroid state
reconstructible_free: none; basis and indexes are serialized explicitly

boundaries: orthogonal exact-metric invariance does not imply query-specific capacity
